instruction: Make the titles in slides 2, 4, and 6 bold and change their color to green

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires making titles in slides 2, 4, and 6 (0-indexed as 1, 3, 5) bold and green RGB(0, 255, 0). Evaluator checks both bold property (all runs must be bold) and exact color match. Partial credit given for each slide with both properties correct (1/3 per slide).

llm_judge_reasons: Complete coverage: Verifies all three target slides (1, 3, 5 corresponding to slides 2, 4, 6)
Correct bold verification: Checks ALL runs in title must be bold
FIXED: Color consistency check now properly verifies ALL runs have consistent color (lines 63-70), resolving previous critical issue
Correct metric parameter handling: Uses expected.get('slides') and expected.get('color') directly (not expected.get('rules'))
Expected values are semantically correct: slides=[1,3,5], color=[0,255,0] (green RGB)
Appropriate postconfig: Saves file before extraction
Robust edge case handling: Returns None for inconsistent colors, handles missing text
Correct partial credit logic: 1/3 score per correct slide with both properties
